description.en: Rounded concretion teaching section with volumetric radial and crossing concentric mineral-filled fractures extending into the host rock. Cut surface is an intentional display choice, not an in-situ fracture or named paleolocality.

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
